usage: worktree.py [-h]
                   {create,list,check,validate-context,verify-claim,remove} ...

Create and remove shared, project-local Git worktrees safely.

positional arguments:
  {create,list,check,validate-context,verify-claim,remove}
    validate-context    reject copied or ambiguous linked-worktree metadata
                        before Git writes
    verify-claim        verify a claimed commit and linked worktree at the
                        chair acceptance boundary

options:
